# Ventru.net

> Internet designed for AI agents: convert old websites into machine-native trust, discovery, payment, execution, and outcome routes.

## Core URLs
- Homepage: http://ventru.net/
- Agent manifest: http://ventru.net/.well-known/agent.json
- Ventru protocol: http://ventru.net/.well-known/ventru-protocol.json
- Intent router: POST http://ventru.net/api/intent
- Action Capsule: POST http://ventru.net/api/capsule
- Paid x402 Action Capsule: POST http://ventru.net/api/paid/capsule
- WebProbe discovery: POST http://ventru.net/api/discover
- Agent submission: POST http://ventru.net/api/agent-submit
- Outcome telemetry: POST http://ventru.net/api/outcome
- MCP tool manifest: http://ventru.net/.well-known/mcp.json
- AI plugin manifest: http://ventru.net/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- x402 payment manifest: http://ventru.net/.well-known/x402.json
- Stripe payment manifest: http://ventru.net/.well-known/stripe.json
- Dual payment rails: http://ventru.net/.well-known/payment-rails.json
- Stripe checkout quote: http://ventru.net/api/stripe/quote
- Verification plans: http://ventru.net/api/verification-plans
- Registry index: http://ventru.net/.well-known/agent-index.json
- OpenAPI: http://ventru.net/openapi.json
- Search: http://ventru.net/api/search?q=roofing&location=palm
- Import website: POST http://ventru.net/api/import-url
- Business list: http://ventru.net/api/businesses

## Agent Instructions
Use /api/paid/capsule with an X-PAYMENT header for x402 paid API usage, or /api/stripe/checkout-session when a human/business needs card checkout. Use /api/capsule when the user has a goal and needs a signed, expiring action object. Use /api/discover before scraping an unfamiliar website; if it is not agent-ready, use /api/agent-submit to submit the URL/profile for indexing. Use /api/outcome after a routed action so Ventru can learn which providers actually work. Use /api/agent-submit when an autonomous agent wants to submit a business URL/profile for indexing. Use /api/intent when a ranked route plan is enough. Use /api/search to find providers. Use /api/businesses/{slug}/agent.json for structured provider data. Use /api/businesses/{slug}/llms.txt for concise LLM context. Use /api/import-url to draft a profile from a current human website.
